## Licence and consent

Please confirm all three. These are the only things that get a pull request
closed rather than sent back for changes, because they are not fixable by
editing the file.

- [ ] **I took these photographs.**
- [ ] **No identifiable people are in frame.**
- [ ] **I license the images and labels in this pull request under
      [CC BY 4.0](../LICENSE).** I keep the copyright; anyone may use the
      material with credit.

## Checklist

<!-- CONTRIBUTING.md has the reasoning for each of these. -->

- [ ] The filename is a slug — lowercase, digits, hyphens — and the file is in
      `archives/<my-github-handle>/`.
- [ ] One camera position per archive. If I moved the camera, that is a separate
      archive.
- [ ] Every image I marked complete really is complete: no unlabeled car in it.
- [ ] I reviewed every proposed label rather than accepting them unread.
- [ ] I included some car-free frames, marked complete. *(Optional, and the most
      useful thing in the list.)*
